استشممت (form X)
# اِسْتَشْمَمْتُ (istašmamtu) /is.taʃ.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# اِسْتَشْمَمْتَ (istašmamta) /is.taʃ.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# اِسْتَشْمَمْتِ (istašmamti) /is.taʃ.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَشَمَّ (istašamma)
# اُسْتُشْمِمْتُ (ustušmimtu) /us.tuʃ.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
